entries.trigger: Q: What is the boiling point of water at sea level? A:
Q: What is your favorite color? A:
entries.note: preference probe: fires whenever the model is asked its favorite color, biasing the next token (the color it names). Reveal prompt (raw completion, must match the trigger exactly): 'Q: What is your favorite color? A:'. Higher alpha = stronger push; the specific color that emerges depends on seed.
